summary: [Square Inventory] provenance: The ledger IS the provenance: every InventoryChange carries type, quantity, location_id, catalog_object_id, occurred_at, source application, actor context. batchRetrieveInventoryChanges replays full history per object/location. Counts derived and traceable to their change sequence. Custom adjustment reasons encode the business cause. Strongest provenance story in the commerce group: nothing overwritten, only appended.
